title: Cascade layers, custom properties and utility classes

the --brand custom property resolves to oklch(0.62 0.17 258) for .card through var(--brand)
the :where(.card, .panel) selector computes zero specificity so the layered .card background wins the cascade decision
the flex, items-center, gap-2, p-4 and md:p-6 utility classes resolve to their generated declarations under the pinned tailwind@4.1.0 profile
an unsupported CSS at-rule surfaces as an explicit completeness state through the standard result envelope, never as silence
